_about: Plain-language labels for game config values shown in the planner. Keys are 'Config.Field'; Car/Bike/Skimmer/Plane prefixes are dropped so one entry covers every vehicle class. unit: shown after numbers. parts: names for each number of a pair/triple. axes: [input, output] names for curves. sure: 'name' = meaning comes from the game's own field name; 'inferred' = worked out from how values behave, not confirmed by game code.

VehicleThrustConfig: How fast the vehicle gets up to speed and how fast it can go.
VehicleRamjetConfig: The heat-based speed boost: how hot it runs, how fast it cools and what it adds.
VehicleAfterburnerConfig: The fuel-based boost: burn time, refill and the speed it adds.
BrakeConfig: How quickly the vehicle slows down.
VehicleBrakeConfig: How quickly the vehicle slows down.
VehicleHealthConfig: How much damage impacts do, and when a hit becomes a crash.
VehicleConditionConfig: Timings and strength of Burning, Frozen, Corroded, Concussed and similar conditions.
CriticalMalfunctionConfig: The repair skill check that appears when the vehicle malfunctions.
VehicleLandingConfig: Landing windows and the reward for a perfect landing.
VehicleIgnitionConfig: The boost from a well-timed start.
VehicleBoostConfig: When Ramjet can be used while affected by conditions.
RaceTuneConfig: Rules that apply to every race.

VehicleThrustConfig.HighSpeedStep.label: Top speed band
VehicleThrustConfig.HighSpeedStep.tip: The speed range where acceleration fades out. The second number behaves as the vehicle's top speed. Each point of power rating raises both by about 4 km/h (6.7 km/h for Podracers).

VehicleThrustConfig.LowSpeedAcceleration.label: Low-speed acceleration
VehicleThrustConfig.LowSpeedAcceleration.tip: Acceleration force in the lowest speed band (from a standstill). Higher is quicker off the line. Internal units.

VehicleThrustConfig.MidSpeedAcceleration.label: Mid-speed acceleration
VehicleThrustConfig.MidSpeedAcceleration.tip: Acceleration force in the middle speed band. Internal units.

VehicleThrustConfig.HighSpeedAcceleratio.label: High-speed acceleration
VehicleThrustConfig.HighSpeedAcceleratio.tip: Acceleration force in the top speed band, before the vehicle reaches top speed. Internal units.

VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeOngoingTopSpeed.label: Surge top-speed bonus
VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeOngoingTopSpeed.tip: Extra top speed for as long as you're Surging.

VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeBoostTopSpeedIn.label: Surge burst top-speed bonus
VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeBoostTopSpeedIn.tip: Extra top speed during the initial burst when Surging starts.

VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeOngoingAccelera.label: Surge acceleration bonus
VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeOngoingAccelera.tip: Extra acceleration while Surging, one number per speed band. Internal units.

VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeBoostAccelerati.label: Surge burst acceleration bonus
VehicleThrustConfig.SurgeBoostAccelerati.tip: Extra acceleration during the initial Surge burst, one number per speed band. Internal units.

VehicleRamjetConfig.TopSpeedIncreaseMph.label: Ramjet top-speed bonus
VehicleRamjetConfig.TopSpeedIncreaseMph.tip: Extra top speed while Ramjet is active.

VehicleRamjetConfig.AdditionalAccelerati.label: Ramjet acceleration bonus
VehicleRamjetConfig.AdditionalAccelerati.tip: Extra acceleration while Ramjet is active, one number per speed band. Internal units.

VehicleRamjetConfig.ActiveHeatingRate.label: Heat build-up while active
VehicleRamjetConfig.ActiveHeatingRate.tip: How fast Ramjet heats up while you're using it. Lower means longer use before overheating.

VehicleRamjetConfig.PassiveHeatingRate.label: Passive heat build-up
VehicleRamjetConfig.PassiveHeatingRate.tip: How fast Ramjet heats up when not in use. Lower is better.

VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeLatchTime.label: Overheat warning time
VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeLatchTime.tip: How long you can stay in the red before Ramjet overheats and crashes you. Longer gives more time to back off.

VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeLatchDraining.label: Overheat warning drains
VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeLatchDraining.tip: When on, the overheat countdown runs back down instead of crashing you, so you can stay in the red longer. Set by Vent.

VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeDrainTime.label: Overheat recovery time
VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeDrainTime.tip: How long the overheat state takes to drain away.

VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeResetChance.label: Chance to survive overheating
VehicleRamjetConfig.ExplodeResetChance.tip: Chance that an overheat resets instead of crashing you.

VehicleRamjetConfig.GraceTime.label: Overheat grace time
VehicleRamjetConfig.GraceTime.tip: Extra time before an overheat takes effect.

VehicleRamjetConfig.NumMaxGraceTimeActiv.label: Overheat grace uses
VehicleRamjetConfig.NumMaxGraceTimeActiv.tip: How many times per race the grace time can save you.

VehicleRamjetConfig.SpeedScaleVsCoolingR.label: Cooling rate by speed
VehicleRamjetConfig.SpeedScaleVsCoolingR.tip: How fast Ramjet cools down depending on your speed.

VehicleRamjetConfig.OverheatedSpeedScale.label: Cooling rate after overheating
VehicleRamjetConfig.OverheatedSpeedScale.tip: How fast Ramjet cools down after it has overheated.

VehicleRamjetConfig.AllowCoolingWhenBoos.label: Cools while boosting
VehicleRamjetConfig.AllowCoolingWhenBoos.tip: Whether Ramjet keeps cooling while you use other boosts.

VehicleAfterburnerConfig.TopSpeedIncreas.label: Afterburner top-speed bonus
VehicleAfterburnerConfig.TopSpeedIncreas.tip: Extra top speed while the afterburner is firing.

VehicleAfterburnerConfig.AdditionalAccel.label: Afterburner acceleration bonus
VehicleAfterburnerConfig.AdditionalAccel.tip: Extra acceleration while the afterburner is firing.

VehicleAfterburnerConfig.BaseEnergyBarCh.label: Afterburner fuel
VehicleAfterburnerConfig.BaseEnergyBarCh.tip: How long a full tank lasts, and how long it takes to refill. Parts that make it 'burn longer' raise the first number.

VehicleAfterburnerConfig.TimeBeforeRegen.label: Refill delay
VehicleAfterburnerConfig.TimeBeforeRegen.tip: How long after you stop using the afterburner before fuel starts refilling. Lower is better.

VehicleAfterburnerConfig.DisabledRateSca.label: Refill rate while disabled
VehicleAfterburnerConfig.DisabledRateSca.tip: Fuel refill speed while the afterburner is disabled, as a multiplier.

SteeringConfig.TurnRadiusMetersAtSpeedMp.label: Turning circle by speed
SteeringConfig.TurnRadiusMetersAtSpeedMp.tip: How wide the vehicle turns at each speed. Smaller radius means tighter turns.

SteeringConfig.MinInputForKnifing.label: Steering needed to knife
SteeringConfig.MinInputForKnifing.tip: How far you must steer before a Skimmer knifes onto its edge. Higher means it knifes less readily.

SteeringConfig.GripSlipAngleGraphLerp.label: Grip curve
SteeringConfig.GripSlipAngleGraphLerp.tip: Picks which of the vehicle's three grip settings applies at each speed: −1 is its low-speed grip, 0 mid-speed and +1 high-speed, blended in between. The numbers aren't amounts of grip. Grip (traction) is strongest at the low-speed setting, so at any speed a lower number means more grip. Upgrades push the curve to higher speeds, so you keep the stronger grip for longer.

SteeringConfig.SideDragSlipAngleGraphLer.label: Slide resistance curve
SteeringConfig.SideDragSlipAngleGraphLer.tip: Picks which of the vehicle's three slide-resistance settings applies at each speed: −1 is its low-speed setting, 0 mid-speed and +1 high-speed, blended in between. The numbers aren't amounts of resistance. Resistance is strongest at the low-speed setting, so at any speed a lower number means less sliding. Upgrades push the curve to higher speeds.

SteeringConfig.RamjetTurnRadiusEffectAtS.label: Turning penalty with Ramjet
SteeringConfig.RamjetTurnRadiusEffectAtS.tip: How much wider you turn while Ramjet is active. Lower is better.

SteeringConfig.RamjetSideDragMultiplier.label: Slide resistance with Ramjet
SteeringConfig.RamjetSideDragMultiplier.tip: Multiplier on sideways grip while Ramjet is active.

SteeringConfig.OffGasTurnRadiusEffectAtS.label: Tighter turns off the throttle
SteeringConfig.OffGasTurnRadiusEffectAtS.tip: How much your turning circle shrinks when you ease off the throttle (negative = tighter).

SteeringConfig.OffGasTurnRadiusThrottleR.label: Throttle response for off-throttle turning
SteeringConfig.OffGasTurnRadiusThrottleR.tip: How much of the off-throttle turning bonus applies at each throttle position.

SteeringConfig.AirBrakeGripMultiplier.label: Air brake grip
SteeringConfig.AirBrakeGripMultiplier.tip: Grip multiplier while using the Podracer air brake.

SteeringConfig.AirBrakeSideDragMultiplie.label: Air brake slide resistance
SteeringConfig.AirBrakeSideDragMultiplie.tip: Sideways grip multiplier while using the air brake.

SteeringConfig.AirBrakeTurnRadiusEffectA.label: Air brake turning
SteeringConfig.AirBrakeTurnRadiusEffectA.tip: How the air brake changes your turning circle at each speed.

SteeringConfig.DriftingTurnRadiusMetersA.label: Drift turning circle
SteeringConfig.DriftingTurnRadiusMetersA.tip: How wide a Landspeeder turns while drifting, at each speed. Smaller radius means tighter drifts.

SteeringConfig.DriftIntentRateFromSteeri.label: Drift build-up from steering
SteeringConfig.DriftIntentRateFromSteeri.tip: How quickly steering hard tips a Landspeeder into a drift. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.DriftIntentRateFromCounte.label: Drift build-up from counter-steering
SteeringConfig.DriftIntentRateFromCounte.tip: How quickly counter-steering builds a Landspeeder's drift. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.DriftIntentDecay.label: Drift fade
SteeringConfig.DriftIntentDecay.tip: How quickly a Landspeeder's drift winds down once you stop steering into it. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.MaintainSpeedRange.label: Drift speed-keeping range
SteeringConfig.MaintainSpeedRange.tip: The speed range over which a drifting Landspeeder holds on to its speed.

SteeringConfig.MaintainScale.label: Drift speed-keeping strength
SteeringConfig.MaintainScale.tip: How strongly a drifting Landspeeder holds on to its speed. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.DriftStrafeSpeeds.label: Drift sideways speed
SteeringConfig.DriftStrafeSpeeds.tip: How fast a drifting Landspeeder slides sideways, one number per speed band.

SteeringConfig.OnEnergyBrakeGripMultipli.label: Energy brake grip
SteeringConfig.OnEnergyBrakeGripMultipli.tip: Grip multiplier while using the Speeder Bike energy brake.

SteeringConfig.OnEnergyBrakeSideDragMult.label: Energy brake slide resistance
SteeringConfig.OnEnergyBrakeSideDragMult.tip: Sideways grip multiplier while using the energy brake.

SteeringConfig.OnEnergyBrakeTurnRadiusEf.label: Energy brake turning
SteeringConfig.OnEnergyBrakeTurnRadiusEf.tip: How the energy brake changes your turning circle at each speed (negative = tighter).

SteeringConfig.KnifingTopSpeedDecreaseMp.label: Top speed lost while knifing
SteeringConfig.KnifingTopSpeedDecreaseMp.tip: How much top speed a Skim Speeder gives up while knifing on its edge. Lower is better.

SteeringConfig.KnifingAccelerationLoss.label: Acceleration lost while knifing
SteeringConfig.KnifingAccelerationLoss.tip: How much acceleration a Skim Speeder gives up while knifing, one number per speed band. Lower is better. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.KnifingTurnRadiusMetersAt.label: Knifing turning circle
SteeringConfig.KnifingTurnRadiusMetersAt.tip: How wide a Skim Speeder turns while knifing, at each speed. Smaller radius means tighter turns.

SteeringConfig.KnifingGripSlipAngleGraph.label: Knifing grip curve
SteeringConfig.KnifingGripSlipAngleGraph.tip: While knifing, picks which of the vehicle's three grip settings applies at each speed: −1 is its low-speed grip, 0 mid-speed and +1 high-speed, blended in between. The numbers aren't amounts of grip. Grip (traction) is strongest at the low-speed setting, so at any speed a lower number means more grip. Upgrades push the curve to higher speeds, so you keep the stronger grip for longer.

SteeringConfig.KnifingSideDragSlipAngleG.label: Knifing slide resistance curve
SteeringConfig.KnifingSideDragSlipAngleG.tip: While knifing, picks which of the vehicle's three slide-resistance settings applies at each speed: −1 is its low-speed setting, 0 mid-speed and +1 high-speed, blended in between. The numbers aren't amounts of resistance. Resistance is strongest at the low-speed setting, so at any speed a lower number means less sliding. Upgrades push the curve to higher speeds.

SteeringConfig.KnifingSlipAngleToGripMul.label: Knifing grip by slide angle
SteeringConfig.KnifingSlipAngleToGripMul.tip: Grip multiplier while knifing, by how far the Skim Speeder is sliding, one curve per speed band.

SteeringConfig.KnifingSlipAngleToSideDra.label: Knifing slide resistance by slide angle
SteeringConfig.KnifingSlipAngleToSideDra.tip: Sideways grip multiplier while knifing, by how far the Skim Speeder is sliding, one curve per speed band.

SteeringConfig.KnifeSteerRates.label: Knifing steering rate
SteeringConfig.KnifeSteerRates.tip: How quickly a Skim Speeder steers while knifing. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.KnifeSteeringRateModifier.label: Knifing steering rate change
SteeringConfig.KnifeSteeringRateModifier.tip: Adjusts how quickly a Skim Speeder steers while knifing. Internal units.

SteeringConfig.FullExplosionOffset.label: Engine-loss steering pull
SteeringConfig.FullExplosionOffset.tip: How hard a Podracer pulls to one side after losing an engine. Lower is easier to control.

SteeringConfig.MaxYankOffset.label: Max steering yank
SteeringConfig.MaxYankOffset.tip: Largest sudden pull on a Podracer's steering. Lower is steadier.

SteeringConfig.ImpactSlipMultiplier.label: Slide after impacts
SteeringConfig.ImpactSlipMultiplier.tip: How much a Podracer slides after being hit. Lower is steadier.

BrakeConfig.Deceleration.label: Brake strength
BrakeConfig.Deceleration.tip: How quickly the vehicle slows when braking. Internal units.

BrakeConfig.EnergyBrakeDeceleration.label: Energy brake strength
BrakeConfig.EnergyBrakeDeceleration.tip: How quickly a Speeder Bike slows with its energy brake. Internal units.

BrakeConfig.AirBrakeDeceleration.label: Air brake strength
BrakeConfig.AirBrakeDeceleration.tip: How quickly a Podracer slows with its air brake. Internal units.

BrakeConfig.FullChargeTime.label: Energy brake charge time
BrakeConfig.FullChargeTime.tip: How long a Speeder Bike's energy brake takes to charge fully. Lower is better.

BrakeConfig.EnergyEconomy.label: Energy brake economy
BrakeConfig.EnergyEconomy.tip: How efficiently a Speeder Bike's energy brake uses its charge. Internal units.

BrakeConfig.ActiveEffectAdditionalAccele.label: Energy brake release boost
BrakeConfig.ActiveEffectAdditionalAccele.tip: Extra acceleration from a charged energy brake, one number per speed band.

VehicleBrakeConfig.Deceleration.label: Brake strength
VehicleBrakeConfig.Deceleration.tip: How quickly the vehicle slows when braking. Internal units.

VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableVs.label: Wall hits to become Vulnerable
VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableVs.tip: Damage a wall or scenery hit deals toward the Vulnerable state. Lower is better.

VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableVs.label: Vehicle hits to become Vulnerable
VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableVs.tip: Damage a hit from another racer deals toward the Vulnerable state. Lower is better.

VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableWh.label: Wall hits while Vulnerable
VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableWh.tip: Damage from scenery hits while already Vulnerable. Lower is better.

VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableWh.label: Vehicle hits while Vulnerable
VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToVulnerableWh.tip: Damage from racer hits while already Vulnerable. Lower is better.

VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToCrashWhenVul.label: Crash chance from wall hits while Vulnerable
VehicleHealthConfig.DamageToCrashWhenVul.tip: How likely a scenery hit is to crash you while Vulnerable.

VehicleHealthConfig.AreaImpactScaleWorld.label: Impact damage by area
VehicleHealthConfig.AreaImpactScaleWorld.tip: Damage multiplier for scenery hits on each part of the vehicle. The game doesn't name the six areas.

VehicleConditionConfig.ChilledStrengthTi.label: Chill build-up to Frozen
VehicleConditionConfig.ChilledStrengthTi.tip: Timings for how Chilled builds up into Frozen. The game doesn't name the two numbers; parts that make you 'take longer to become Frozen' change them.

VehicleConditionConfig.ChilledStrengthWh.label: Chill build-up while Heated
VehicleConditionConfig.ChilledStrengthWh.tip: Chill build-up timings when your Ramjet is hot.

VehicleConditionConfig.ChilledStrengthTi.label: Chill build-up multiplier when Frozen
VehicleConditionConfig.ChilledStrengthTi.tip: Multiplier on chill timings once Frozen.

VehicleConditionConfig.ConcussedActivati.label: Concussed timing
VehicleConditionConfig.ConcussedActivati.tip: How quickly the Concussed condition takes hold.

VehicleConditionConfig.CorrodingActivati.label: Corroded timing
VehicleConditionConfig.CorrodingActivati.tip: How quickly the Corroded condition takes hold.

VehicleConditionConfig.CorrodingExplosio.label: Corroded crash timer
VehicleConditionConfig.CorrodingExplosio.tip: How long until Corroded makes you crash. Higher is better.

VehicleConditionConfig.ConcussedTimerMul.label: Concussed duration
VehicleConditionConfig.ConcussedTimerMul.tip: Multiplier on how long Concussed lasts.

VehicleConditionConfig.FrozenTimerMultip.label: Frozen duration
VehicleConditionConfig.FrozenTimerMultip.tip: Multiplier on how long Frozen lasts.

VehicleConditionConfig.MalfunctionTimerM.label: System Malfunction duration
VehicleConditionConfig.MalfunctionTimerM.tip: Multiplier on how long System Malfunction lasts.

VehicleConditionConfig.CooledExtension.label: Cooled extension
VehicleConditionConfig.CooledExtension.tip: Extra time the Cooled condition lasts.

VehicleConditionConfig.CooledTuneSetStre.label: Cooled strength
VehicleConditionConfig.CooledTuneSetStre.tip: How strong the Cooled condition's effect is. Higher is stronger.

VehicleConditionConfig.BurningTuneSetStr.label: Burning strength
VehicleConditionConfig.BurningTuneSetStr.tip: How strong the Burning condition's effect is on you. Lower is better.

VehicleConditionConfig.FrozenTuneSetStre.label: Frozen strength
VehicleConditionConfig.FrozenTuneSetStre.tip: How strong the Frozen condition's effect is on you. Lower is better.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.SuccessStart.label: Skill check: success zone start
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.SuccessStart.tip: Where the success zone of the repair skill check begins (0–1 along the bar). Moving it earlier makes the zone wider.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.SuccessEnd.label: Skill check: success zone end
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.SuccessEnd.tip: Where the success zone ends (0–1 along the bar).

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.PassResolution.label: Skill check: recovery after a pass
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.PassResolution.tip: Time to recover after passing the check. Lower is better.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.PerfectPassRes.label: Skill check: recovery after a perfect pass
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.PerfectPassRes.tip: Time to recover after a perfect pass. Lower is better.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.FailedResoluti.label: Skill check: recovery after a fail
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.FailedResoluti.tip: Time to recover after failing the check. Lower is better.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.TimeOutResolut.label: Skill check: recovery after timing out
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.TimeOutResolut.tip: Time to recover if you don't press in time.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.MalfunctionSta.label: Malfunction build-up at start
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.MalfunctionSta.tip: How much malfunction pressure you start with. Lower is better.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.MalfunctionTri.label: Malfunction build-up when triggered
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.MalfunctionTri.tip: How much pressure each trigger adds. Lower is better.

CriticalMalfunctionConfig.MalfunctionDra.label: Malfunction drain delay
CriticalMalfunctionConfig.MalfunctionDra.tip: How long before built-up malfunction pressure starts draining. Lower is better.

VehicleDraftingConfig.DelayBeforeDecay.label: Slipstream bonus hold time
VehicleDraftingConfig.DelayBeforeDecay.tip: How long Slipstream bonuses stay at full strength after you leave the slipstream, before they start fading.

VehicleDraftingConfig.TopSpeedIncreaseMp.label: Slipstream top-speed bonus
VehicleDraftingConfig.TopSpeedIncreaseMp.tip: Extra top speed while drafting behind another racer.

VehicleDraftingConfig.AdditionalAccelera.label: Slipstream acceleration bonus
VehicleDraftingConfig.AdditionalAccelera.tip: Extra acceleration while drafting, one number per speed band. Internal units.

VehicleDraftingConfig.DecayRate.label: Slipstream decay
VehicleDraftingConfig.DecayRate.tip: How fast the drafting bonus fades after leaving the slipstream. Lower lasts longer.

VehicleDraftingConfig.MediumOriginScale.label: Medium slipstream zone
VehicleDraftingConfig.MediumOriginScale.tip: Size of the medium-strength drafting zone behind a racer.

VehicleDraftingConfig.StrongOriginScale.label: Strong slipstream zone
VehicleDraftingConfig.StrongOriginScale.tip: Size of the strongest drafting zone, closest behind a racer.

VehicleLandingConfig.PerfectLandingBound.label: Perfect landing window
VehicleLandingConfig.PerfectLandingBound.tip: The landing angle range that counts as a Perfect Landing. A wider range is more forgiving.

VehicleLandingConfig.GoodLandingBounds.label: Good landing window
VehicleLandingConfig.GoodLandingBounds.tip: The landing angle range that counts as a good landing.

VehicleLandingConfig.PerfectLandingDurat.label: Perfect landing boost length
VehicleLandingConfig.PerfectLandingDurat.tip: How long the speed boost from a Perfect Landing lasts.

VehicleLandingConfig.PerfectLandingAccel.label: Perfect landing boost strength
VehicleLandingConfig.PerfectLandingAccel.tip: Acceleration added by a Perfect Landing. Internal units.

VehicleIgnitionConfig.BoostAdditionalAcc.label: Perfect start acceleration
VehicleIgnitionConfig.BoostAdditionalAcc.tip: Extra acceleration from a well-timed start. Internal units.

VehicleIgnitionConfig.BoostTopSpeedIncre.label: Perfect start top-speed bonus
VehicleIgnitionConfig.BoostTopSpeedIncre.tip: Extra top speed from a well-timed start.

VehicleBoostConfig.CanRamjetMaintainWhen.label: Ramjet kept while Choked
VehicleBoostConfig.CanRamjetMaintainWhen.tip: Normally Choked cancels an active Ramjet.

VehicleGameplayConfig.Power.label: Speed stat
VehicleGameplayConfig.Power.tip: Points on the build screen's Speed stat, not km/h. Each point raises top speed by about 4 km/h (6.7 km/h on a Podracer), so +5 is roughly +20 km/h. Effects that say 'every' (e.g. every takedown) stack each time they trigger.

VehicleGameplayConfig.Cornering.label: Cornering stat
VehicleGameplayConfig.Cornering.tip: Points on the build screen's Cornering stat.

VehicleGameplayConfig.Advanced.label: Advanced stat
VehicleGameplayConfig.Advanced.tip: Points on the build screen's Advanced stat.

VehicleGameplayConfig.CanBeTargetted.label: Can be targeted
VehicleGameplayConfig.CanBeTargetted.tip: Whether opponents' abilities can lock on to you.

AbilityTuneConfig.TotalAbilityEnergy.label: Ability energy
AbilityTuneConfig.TotalAbilityEnergy.tip: Energy available for abilities. Each ability use costs energy.

AbilityTuneConfig.GlobalCooldownScale.label: Ability reload time
AbilityTuneConfig.GlobalCooldownScale.tip: Multiplier on every ability's reload time. Lower reloads faster: ×0.5 means twice as fast.

RaceTuneConfig.TotalCrashAllowance.label: Crashes allowed per event
RaceTuneConfig.TotalCrashAllowance.tip: How many times you can crash before being knocked out of an event.

CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumAffixesAvailab.label: Parts on offer
CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumAffixesAvailab.tip: Parts the shop offers per visit.

CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumVehiclePartsAv.label: Upgrades on offer
CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumVehiclePartsAv.tip: Vehicle upgrades the shop offers per visit.

CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumAbilitiesAvail.label: Abilities on offer
CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumAbilitiesAvail.tip: Abilities the shop offers per visit.

CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumAffixesOnSpeci.label: Discounted parts
CampaignShopTuneConfig.NumAffixesOnSpeci.tip: How many shop parts are on special discount.

CampaignShopTuneConfig.AffixSpecialDisco.label: Special discount
CampaignShopTuneConfig.AffixSpecialDisco.tip: Discount on the specially discounted parts.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.NumberOfEndOfE.label: Reward choices after an event
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.NumberOfEndOfE.tip: How many rewards you choose from after each event.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.CreditsFromEnd.label: Credits from event rewards
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.CreditsFromEnd.tip: Multiplier on credits earned from end-of-event rewards.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.AffixGeneratio.label: Extra Rare part weight
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.AffixGeneratio.tip: Raises the chance that reward parts are Rare.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.AffixGeneratio.label: Extra Epic part weight
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.AffixGeneratio.tip: Raises the chance that reward parts are Epic.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.AffixGeneratio.label: Extra Legendary part weight
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.AffixGeneratio.tip: Raises the chance that reward parts are Legendary.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.UpgradeLevelBo.label: Upgrade reward level weights
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.UpgradeLevelBo.tip: Weights for upgrade rewards rolling at a higher level.

CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.bIncreaseGaure.label: Guaranteed part rarity +1
CampaignRewardsTuneConfig.bIncreaseGaure.tip: The guaranteed reward part is one rarity tier higher.

CampaignTuneConfig.BonusStrikes.label: Bonus strikes
CampaignTuneConfig.BonusStrikes.tip: Extra strikes (League Tokens) in the campaign.

CampaignTuneConfig.CarryoverCreditsFlatB.label: Carry-over credits
CampaignTuneConfig.CarryoverCreditsFlatB.tip: Credits carried into the next tour.

CampaignTuneConfig.BonusChanceForBlackMa.label: Black market chance
CampaignTuneConfig.BonusChanceForBlackMa.tip: Extra chance for black market stops to appear on the map.

CampaignTuneConfig.ChanceMechanicBonusSt.label: Mechanic bonus-strike chance
CampaignTuneConfig.ChanceMechanicBonusSt.tip: Chance of getting a strike back from the Mechanic after being knocked out.

BlackMarketTuneConfig.AffixRepairDiscoun.label: Faulty part repair discount
BlackMarketTuneConfig.AffixRepairDiscoun.tip: Discount on repairing Faulty parts at the black market.
